d.ko:
Combat Arms: the Classic is a multiplayer game, free-to-play modern first-person shooter. 
The game is a relaunch of Combat Arms in its glory days delivering gamers a nostalgic high-quality FPS with an extensive arsenal of weapons.
d.en:
Combat Arms: the Classic is a multiplayer game, free-to-play modern first-person shooter. 
The game is a relaunch of Combat Arms in its glory days delivering gamers a nostalgic high-quality FPS with an extensive arsenal of weapons.
d.zh: Combat Arms是一款免费的多人现代第一人称射击游戏，凭借其各种各样的可定制武器和已知的游戏模式，它为游戏玩家提供了高质量的FPS体验。
